subsystems.name: Telemetry pipeline
subsystems.role: collects and normalises signals from endpoints, network, cloud and identity systems into one searchable stream.

subsystems.name: Detection layer
subsystems.role: turns raw events into alerts worth investigating.

subsystems.name: Context store
subsystems.role: tells the agent what it is looking at, so it can judge severity and blast radius.

subsystems.name: Reasoning agents
subsystems.role: investigate an alert the way a human analyst would, but faster.
parts: retrieval over runbooks, threat reports and past tickets

subsystems.name: Response orchestration
subsystems.role: acts on the environment through scoped, permissioned APIs.

subsystems.name: Guardrails and audit
subsystems.role: keeps autonomy bounded and every decision reviewable.

buildSteps.title: Centralise the telemetry
buildSteps.detail: Ship endpoint, network, cloud and identity logs into one store and normalise them to a shared schema, so a single query can join a login, a process start and a network connection.

buildSteps.title: Map assets and identities
buildSteps.detail: Build an inventory that resolves every IP address and account to a machine, an owner, a criticality rating and its current patch level — an agent cannot judge risk without this.

buildSteps.title: Encode detections
buildSteps.detail: Write deterministic rules for known-bad behaviour and train behavioural baselines per user and host, then map everything to a shared adversary-tactics taxonomy such as MITRE ATT&CK.

buildSteps.title: Ground the model
buildSteps.detail: Index runbooks, threat-intelligence reports and past incident tickets for retrieval, and require the agent to cite the evidence and the source document behind every conclusion.

buildSteps.title: Give it tools, read-only first
buildSteps.detail: Expose APIs to query the endpoint agent, the ticketing system, the identity provider and the vulnerability scanner. Let the agent look and correlate but change nothing yet.

buildSteps.title: Add the policy layer
buildSteps.detail: Define which actions are allowed, on which asset classes, under what conditions. Enforce dry-run mode, rate limits and an explicit approval step for anything destructive or wide-reaching.

buildSteps.title: Replay and red-team
buildSteps.detail: Run the agent against recorded history and live purple-team exercises, measuring false positives, missed detections and — critically — wrong actions, then tune prompts, retrieval and policy.

buildSteps.title: Grant narrow write actions
buildSteps.detail: Allow the reversible, low-blast-radius moves first: open a ticket, isolate one host, block a file hash, force a password reset. Log outcomes and expand the allowlist only as accuracy holds.

buildSteps.title: Close the loop on patching
buildSteps.detail: Feed confirmed vulnerabilities into the rollout system, deploy fixes inside maintenance windows with automatic rollback, and let the agent verify the fix rather than assume it.

prerequisites.tech: Language models with reliable tool use
prerequisites.why: long-context reasoning over messy logs still drifts, and a hallucinated action in a security tool is worse than no action.
keeps the agent anchored to runbooks and real intelligence instead of inventing plausible-sounding explanations.

prerequisites.tech: Endpoint detection and response agents with APIs
prerequisites.why: they are the eyes and hands on each machine — without them there is nothing to investigate or isolate.

prerequisites.tech: Normalised asset, identity and vulnerability data
prerequisites.why: many organisations hold this in incompatible silos, which blocks any reliable risk or blast-radius judgement.

prerequisites.tech: Safe automated change and patch deployment
prerequisites.why: autonomous patching inherits the oldest problem in IT: fixes that break production.
gives detections, agent reasoning and human review a common vocabulary.

pathway.milestone: AI copilots summarise and prioritise alerts while deterministic playbooks handle known cases
pathway.unlocks: analysts spend less time reading raw logs and more time on genuine investigations.

pathway.milestone: agents run full investigations on low-severity alerts and propose containment, with a human approving the action
pathway.unlocks: round-the-clock triage without expanding the night shift.

pathway.milestone: autonomous containment and patching inside enforced policy, with automatic rollback and full audit trails
pathway.unlocks: response times measured in seconds rather than hours.

pathway.milestone: closed-loop defence where humans set policy, hunt novel attacks and audit agent decisions
pathway.unlocks: a security posture that scales with the volume of attacks rather than with headcount.
